notes.title: Adak Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a soft-lock that happened when a player approached Adak via ship from the east and disembarked on a specific tile.

notes.title: Last dungeon Chosen failsafe hotfix
notes.content: Added a hotfix that should prevent the battle with the chosen from bugging out.

notes.title: Alchemy hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug with alchemy where using aether roots as concoction base wouldn't spend them.

notes.title: Adak achievement hotfix
notes.content: Added a trigger to grant the Adak plantation achievement if the player finishes the dungeon before receiving the quest.

notes.title: Ferry house hotfix
notes.content: Moved the transitions to the ferry houses in Adak and Thaiza away from the coast to avoid the possibility of the player getting the ship stuck.

notes.title: Civil war hotfix
notes.content: Should prevent the first provincial army scene from playing after finishing the civil war questline with the peace faction.

notes.title: Patch notes for September 17th
notes.content:
Removed the annoying white flash when a combat encounter begins.
Fixed the shapeshifting aether weapon so that it shouldn't copy itself anymore.
Fixed situations that cause the Witch Hunt and Brawler achievements to not trigger.
Fixed the speed boost from the cutscene where the princess takes you to meet the emperor.
Added a simple explanation about MP and TP to the combat tutorial.
Fixed a variety of spelling and grammar mistakes.
Reformatted and/or rewrote some dialog to look more pleasing.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content: Fixed minor bugs and spelling mistakes.

notes.title: Resistance patch
notes.content: Tweaked enemy resistance and vulnerability numbers to make them have a more visible effect on gameplay.

notes.title: Achievement hotfix
notes.content: The achievements should now work properly.
